title: Receiving the Dynamite Power of Pentecost
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he explores the transformative power of the Holy Spirit and its impact on the early Church. In this sermon, Pastor Zehner delves into the biblical account of Pentecost and the upper room, revealing the explosive power that God desires to unleash in the lives of believers. Discover how you can experience the dynamic power of the Holy Spirit and be equipped to be a witness to the world.
